# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          root_candidate = node
          ancestor = node.parent
          while ancestor
            if ancestor.or_type?
              root_candidate = ancestor
              ancestor = ancestor.parent
            else
              break
            end
          end
          return unless node == root_candidate

          left_side = node.lhs
          right_side = node.rhs
          pending_parts = [left_side, right_side]
          comparison_leaves = true
          while pending_parts.any?
            part = pending_parts.pop
            if part.or_type?
              pending_parts << part.lhs
              pending_parts << part.rhs
              next
            end
            unless simple_comparison?(part)
              comparison_leaves = false
              pending_parts.clear
            end
          end
          return unless comparison_leaves

          name_segments = self.class.name.split('::')
          department_name = name_segments[2]
          cop_identifier = name_segments[3]
          qualified_name = "#{department_name}/#{cop_identifier}"
          department_config = lookup_department_config(department_name)
          cop_settings = lookup_cop_config(qualified_name)
          merged_settings = if department_config
                              department_config.merge(cop_settings)
                            else
                              cop_settings
                            end
          allow_method_comparison = merged_settings.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
          threshold = merged_settings.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)

          variables = Set.new
          values = []
          worklist = [node]
          while worklist.any?
            current = worklist.pop
            if current.or_type?
              worklist << current.rhs
              worklist << current.lhs
              next
            end
            if simple_double_comparison?(current)
              next
            end
            compared = simple_comparison?(current)
            if compared
              var, obj = compared
              skip_call = allow_method_comparison && obj.call_type?
              if skip_call
                next
              end
              variables << var
              if variables.size > 1
                next
              end
              values << obj
            end
          end

          return if values.size < threshold

          variable = variables.first
          first_parent = values.first.parent
          last_parent = values.last.parent
          first_range = first_parent.source_range
          last_range = last_parent.source_range
          range = range_between(first_range.begin_pos, last_range.end_pos)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, '(send $lvar :== $lvar)'

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $lvar :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== $lvar)
        PATTERN

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            [var, obj]
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

      a = "a"
      if a == "a" || a == "b"
         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.
        print a
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      a = "a"
      if ["a", "b"].include?(a)
        print a
      end
    RUBY

  it 'registers an offense and corrects when `a` is compared three times' do

      a = "a"

         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.
        print a
      end
    RUBY

    expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
      a = "a"
      if ["a", "b", "c"].include?(a)
        print a
      end
    RUBY

    RUBY

      end
    RUBY

    RUBY

    RUBY

    RUBY

        print a
      end
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for Array#include?' do
